SELECT a.id AS applyId, r.id AS resultId, s.std_nm AS studentName, s.std_no AS studentId, s.scsbjt_cd AS studentMajor, a.type_cd AS counselingType, a.stat_cd AS status, a.aply_dttm AS applyDateTime, r.cnsl_cn AS resultContent, r.satisf_score AS satisfactionScore FROM cnsl_aply a JOIN empl_info e ON a.empl_no = e.empl_no JOIN std_info s ON a.std_no = s.std_no LEFT JOIN cnsl_rslt r ON a.cnsl_aply_id = r.cnsl_aply_id LEFT JOIN com_info d ON s.scsbjt_cd = d.com_no
ORDER BY a.aply_dttm DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cnsl_aply a JOIN empl_info e ON a.empl_no = e.empl_no JOIN std_info s ON a.std_no = s.std_no
SELECT a.id AS applyId, r.id AS resultId, r.cnsl_cn AS resultContent FROM cnsl_rslt r JOIN cnsl_aply a ON r.cnsl_aply_id = a.cnsl_aply_id WHERE r.id = #{resultId}
